author: Karl Rock
description:
After trying different types of biryani across India and Pakistan, I didn’t expect to say this - but I might actually prefer Bengali biryani over Hyderabadi biryani.

This sparked a full biryani debate! From Kolkata biryani with its unique flavours to the famous Hyderabadi biryani known across India, everyone has a strong opinion.

So now it’s your turn — which is better?
Hyderabadi or Bengali biryani?
title: Bengali Biryani vs. Hyderabadi
